purpose: Authenticate control of one research response for GDPR rights handling without collecting or maintaining a direct-identity registry.

proof_model.response_id: opaque SHA-256 receipt returned after accepted submission
proof_model.private_verification_code: the browser-generated UUIDv4 used for that submission's idempotency header; shown to the respondent after acceptance and never stored raw by the research application
proof_model.verification: for each allowed form, recompute SHA-256(research_id + ':' + form_id + ':' + private_verification_code) and compare in constant time with response_id
proof_model.meaning: proof of possession/control of the original high-entropy submission credential; not proof of civil identity

implementation.browser: research_form.js displays response_id plus the private verification code only after a successful accepted submission; no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookie persistence
implementation.request_handling: requester supplies response_id and private verification code through the dedicated privacy channel; an authorised operator verifies the pair before any access, rectification, erasure, restriction or objection action
implementation.record_existence_check: after proof verification, the live research store must independently confirm that the response_id still exists before disclosure or mutation
implementation.lost_code_rule: do not create an identity linkage or search CRM/IP/device data to replace a lost private code; apply Article 11 and assess only additional information voluntarily supplied by the requester where legally appropriate

security.credential_rotation: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_SUBMITTED_RESPONSE; a lost credential does not justify identity-registry creation
security.error_handling: no secret value may be logged or echoed in server errors

remaining_live_gate: provider-bound TEST TWIN must prove that the displayed code is not persisted or logged and that authorised rights operations accept a valid pair and reject malformed/non-matching pairs without CRM/IP/device fallback.
